extension: Optional passages/mathQuestions batches and teacher-only review metadata; legacy passage envelopes remain accepted.

root.passage: One passage object OR omit and use passages
root.question: Optional single Math question instead of mathQuestions; no batch metadata required. The Content Editor also accepts a bare Math question object and assigns a stable ID if omitted for a single question.
root.mathQuestions: Ordered Math question objects (optional); imported directly into the selected Math test and marked red for editing
root.batch: Optional MathBatch metadata for matching source questions across chunks and retries
root.review: Optional Review for this complete chunk; expectedQuestionCount counts only this payload
root.visuals: Visual[]; legacy scope/description objects are accepted

mathBatch.sourceId: stable source identity including exam/form/version, supplied by teacher; never a question number alone
mathBatch.jobId: stable job identifier within this source; use the same value on continuation chunks; requires sourceId
mathBatch.requestedScope: teacher request: selected question numbers, range, 1-based PDF pages, or full section
mathBatch.expectedQuestions: unique original source question strings in source order; known inventory, not just this chunk
mathBatch.expectedTotal: nonnegative integer or null if unknown; job-wide total
mathBatch.inventoryConfirmed: boolean; true only if the complete inventory was established from source
mathBatch.chunkId: distinct identifier for this complete chunk; repeat unchanged on exact retry
mathBatch.completedQuestions: source question strings captured in complete chunks so far
mathBatch.unresolvedQuestions: source question strings still requiring extraction or correction
mathBatch.nextScope: exact next source question/page scope; blank only if none remains

passage.title: string; blank allowed in draft, teacher title required to publish
passage.author: string
passage.byline: optional exact printed author/byline, including its prefix
passage.subtitle: optional exact subtitle displayed below title
passage.label: string
passage.text: complete text; empty for independent questions
passage.richText: optional faithful HTML: p, br, strong, em, u, sup, sub, h1-h6, ul, ol, li; text remains the plain-text copy; h1-h6 are unnumbered subheadings; p data-numbered=false excludes a paragraph, true explicitly numbers it

question.topic: exact section topic; for math, the main sorting category; empty when uncertain
question.subtopic: math only: exact specific topic under topic in mathSpecificTopics; empty when uncertain
question.points: positive number; default 1 (platform scoring, not source difficulty)
question.choices: ordered {id:string,text:string,html?:string,math?:string}[]; 2–8 when present; IDs normalized by position: A, B, C, D (then E, F for additional choices)
question.correctChoiceId: multiple_choice: exact choice ID, or empty string/null if no unambiguous supplied key
question.correctChoiceIds: multi_select: choice IDs from key, or [] if unknown
question.requiredSelections: multi_select: source selection count, or null if unknown
question.entryVariable: numeric_entry/grid_in: optional single letter displayed before = for x_equals; defaults to x; preserve the source variable, e.g. w
question.explanation: exact supplied explanation or empty string/null

dropdownContent: Text before {{answer-1}} and after. Multiple {{ids}} can share a line.

items.text: exact text with optional LaTeX delimiters

mathInteractions.richText: promptHtml, stimulusHtml, instructionsHtml are optional faithful rich HTML with LaTeX delimiters. Uploaded images may appear between paragraphs as img with src=/exam-images/existing-file, alt, and optional width. Never invent asset references.

review.sourceQuestion: original printed number as string (question only)
review.sourceChoiceIds: optional original printed choice IDs in order; teacher-only
review.difficulty: source label or empty string; not required by passage/exam model

visual.scope: Passage or original Question number / choice label
visual.questionId: exact output question id, or empty string for passage
visual.choiceId: exact choice id, or empty string
visual.description: concise faithful description of the required visual
visual.state: unresolved on extraction; resolved only by teacher after upload
visual.image: omit unless an actual existing /exam-images/ uploaded image {src,alt,caption?} was supplied; never invent URLs
